title: Aye baba husaina
body:
Aye baba husaina
(Shaam e ghariba'n) ..(2)
Aye Shaam e ghariba'n
Jab Shaam e ghariba'n me yaad e padar aayi Aur ghabrake SAKINA sare maqtal chali aayi
Daaman tha jala aur labo'n par tha yeh nauha
(Aye Baba HUSSAINA) ..(2)
<<MINI>>
(Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA) ..(2)
Roti hain SAKINA, pyaasi hain SAKINA
Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA
<<DIVIDER>>
(1) Hain aap jaha baba, mujhko bula lijiye
Ek baar mujhe, apne seene pe sula lijiye
Bin aap ke duniya me bekaar hai yeh jeena
<<MINI>>
(Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA) ..(2)
Roti hain SAKINA, pyaasi hain SAKINA
Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA
<<DIVIDER>>
(2) Hain kaan mere zakhmi, aur khoon bhi hain jaari
Khaymo'n ki, ridaaon ki, karti hu Azadari
Kuch der sukoon pau, mil jao agar Baba
<<MINI>>
(Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA) ..(2)
Roti hain SAKINA, pyaasi hain SAKINA
Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA
<<DIVIDER>>
(3) Kis samt tumhe dhundhu, maqtal me bhatakti hu
Baba ki samajhkar mai, har laash pe girti hu
Imdaad karo meri, batlao mujhe rasta
<<MINI>>
(Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA) .. (2)
Roti hain SAKINA, pyaasi hain SAKINA
Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA
<<DIVIDER>>
(4) Kuch der lipatkar main, bas aapke laashe se
Woh dard sunaugi, baad aapke jo paye
Har baat batau main, mil jaye agar lasha
<<MINI>>
(Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA) ..(2)
Roti hain SAKINA, pyaasi hain SAKINA
Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA
<<DIVIDER>>
(5) Is dasht me roti hu, sab chahne walo'n ko
Har samt andhera hai, tarsi hu ujalo'n ko
Baad apke aye Baba, taareek hai yeh duniya
<<MINI>>
(Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA) ..(2)
Roti hain SAKINA, pyaasi hain SAKINA (S.A)
Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA
<<DIVIDER>>
(6) SHABBIR  ke nauhe se, phir gunj utha sehra
Ho tere masaeb par, qurban tera Baba
Ek teer laga dil par, sunkar yeh tera girya
<<MINI>>
(Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA) ..(2)
Roti hain SAKINA, pyaasi hain SAKINA
Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA
<<DIVIDER>>
(7) Irfan bhi rota hain, is baat pe Mazhar bhi
Roti thi SAKINA bhi, aur lashaye sarwar bhi
Awaaz e padar sunkar, us samt chali dukhiya
<<MINI>>
(Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA) ..(2)
Roti hain SAKINA, pyaasi hain SAKINA
Ayna ayna aye Baba HUSSAINA
<<DIVIDER>>
aye Baba HUSSAINA..(2)
